1. **Discovery & Translational Science**

- **[Biotech]** **[Chemotherapy synergy with viral-vector vaccines in mice](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/chemotherapy-actually-helps-immunotherapy-cancer)** — *Science*
  - Simultaneous administration of carboplatin plus paclitaxel (CarboTaxol) with viral-vector therapeutic vaccines in mice improved vaccine performance compared to vaccine alone.
  - While previous studies attributed this benefit strictly to chemotherapy-induced myeloid depletion, a detailed analysis of T cells and myeloid cells indicates additional underlying mechanisms.

- **[Selective TNKS2 inhibitor for tumor-restricted WNT suppression](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42972081/)** — *PubMed*
  - Researchers identified and characterized a selective TNKS2 inhibitor designed to achieve tumor-restricted WNT signaling suppression.

- **[GAK as a clinically actionable drug target in DLBCL](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42972012/)** — *PubMed*
  - Cyclin-G associated kinase (GAK) was identified as a required target for mitosis in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) and a clinically actionable drug target.

- **[LRH-1 agonist ME610 reverses metabolic dysfunction in obesity](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.28.761933)** — *BioRxiv*
  - Development of ME610, a potent liver receptor homolog-1 (LRH-1; NR5A2) agonist tested in humanized Nr5a2humLBD mice.
  - In diet-induced obesity models, ME610 dose-dependently induced target genes, reduced triglycerides, and improved insulin sensitivity via coordinated multi-omics shifts centered on peroxisomal lipid metabolism.

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**

- **[Biotech]** **[Phase 1b trial of live biotherapeutic SER-155 in allogeneic HCT](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04686-y)** — *Nature Medicine*
  - An open-label and randomized-controlled Phase 1b trial evaluated SER-155, an investigational cultivated multi-strain bacterial oral live biotherapeutic product, in adult allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation recipients.
  - SER-155 demonstrated a safety profile comparable to placebo and reduced bloodstream infections, supporting further clinical investigation.

- **[Phase 2 trial of sitagliptin in pancreatic cancer](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42971953/)** — *PubMed*
  - Results from the SITGEM-CARE Phase 2 trial show that repurposed diabetes drug sitagliptin overcomes gemcitabine resistance in pancreatic cancer via ribonucleotide reductase inhibition.

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**

- **[TAVR in moderate aortic stenosis with at-risk features](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2607326?af=R&rss=currentIssue)** — *NEJM*
  - Registrational trial data evaluated transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) in patients with moderate aortic stenosis presenting with at-risk features.

4. **Regulatory & Approvals**

- **[Big Pharma]** **[FDA approves atezolizumab for dMMR Stage III colon cancer](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/fda-approves-atezolizumab-combination-chemotherapy-stage-iii-mismatch-repair-deficient-colon-cancer)** — *FDA*
  - The FDA approved atezolizumab (Tecentriq, Genentech) and its hyaluronidase co-formulation (Tecentriq Hybreza) in combination with fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin for adjuvant treatment of adult and pediatric patients (aged 2+ for Tecentriq, 12+ for the hyaluronidase combination) with Stage III mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) colon cancer, based on the ATOMIC/ML39057 (NCT02912559) trial.

- **[Big Pharma]** **[FDA approves once-weekly insulin Awiqli in pediatric type 2 diabetes](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/fda-approves-first-once-weekly-insulin-type-2-diabetes-mellitus-pediatric-patients)** — *FDA*
  - The FDA approved Awiqli (insulin icodec-abae) injection as an adjunct to diet and exercise for glycemic control in pediatric patients aged 10 years and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus, marking the first once-weekly insulin approval for pediatric T2D.

- **[FDA issues final potency assurance guidance for cell and gene therapy](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-provides-clarity-support-cell-and-gene-therapy-development-and-quality)** — *FDA*
  - CBER released a final guidance replacing the 2011 document, recommending that CGT manufacturers implement a comprehensive Potency Assurance Strategy across every stage of the product lifecycle.

- **[CDER updates Manual of Policies & Procedures](http://www.fda.gov/about-fda/center-drug-evaluation-and-research-cder/cder-manual-policies-procedures-mapp)** — *CDER MAPP*
  - Recent revisions include MAPP 5017.2 Rev. 2 on assessing impurity acceptance criteria based on clinical relevance for NDAs, ANDAs, and BLAs, and MAPP 5015.13 Rev. 1 covering quality assessment for products in expedited programs.

5. **Business & Strategy**

- **[Biotech]** **[Karyopharm files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and plans asset auction](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/karyopharm-bankruptcy-chapter-11-auction-ayrmid-gamida-cell/873415/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  - Cash-strapped blood cancer drugmaker Karyopharm Therapeutics filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy to execute a sale and reorganization.
  - Ayrmid, parent of Gamida Cell, is positioned as the lead bidder in an auction backed by a $55 million debtor-in-possession loan, with the transaction expected to close in early 2027.

6. **Public Health & Policy**

- **[Medicare Part D premiums projected to surge 50% in 2027](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/medicare-part-d-premiums-skyrocket-2027-kff/873552/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  - A KFF analysis reports that average monthly premiums for standalone Medicare prescription drug plans are set to increase from $34 to $51 in 2027 following the expiration of a federal premium-limiting program.

- **[First U.S. bird flu death reported in Washington state](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/03/health-news-first-us-bird-flu-death-after-cattle-exposure-2026/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  - A Washington state resident has died from complications of avian influenza following exposure to infected cattle, marking the first U.S. bird flu fatality of the year.

- **[Child dies of measles in New York](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/03/child-dies-measles-new-york-first-death-30-years/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  - A child in rural northern New York has died from measles, marking the state's first mortality from the virus in 30 years.

**Worth watching**: Implementation impacts of the FDA's new CGT potency assurance framework on early-stage manufacturing pipelines.

- Biology & Health
    - [Digital Health Vitals, Ep. 12: OpenEvidence for Sale? Walmart Health & HealthTech Q3 Funding Report](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nMMU8MLr7DU) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Rock Health's Q3 2026 report highlights $11.1 billion in digital health funding, prompting a debate on whether VC-backed healthcare startups outperform bootstrapped businesses.
        - Panelists analyze OpenEvidence's controversial $15 billion valuation and potential acquisition, questioning the sustainability of its business model and the defensibility of physician adoption as a moat.
        - Doximity's partnership with UpToDate is examined in the context of the race to build the ultimate clinical AI assistant and the balance between human medical expertise and AI-generated answers.
        - Walmart re-enters the healthcare space by launching a healthcare marketplace focused on General Medicine.
        - Anthropic's potential IPO is discussed alongside its ambitions in medicine and drug discovery, weighed against its massive computing costs and the broader AI investment bubble.
